Evidence check. govt_data_hosted 'Designated national / government data centre' → 'Unknown': the government data centre in the sources is CNIAPGE's, not GITGE's Sipopo facility. expansion_plans 'No plans' → 'Unknown': no source addresses expansion. key_tenants 'Telecom operators; ISPs; government agencies' → 'None confirmed': no source names a tenant. hyperscaler_relationships rewritten: the Microsoft licence is CNIAPGE's, not this facility's, and a licence is not a relationship. hyperscaler_microsoft 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_aws 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_google 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. chinese_involvement 'Construction/Equipment' → 'None identified': no source names ZTE; Huawei Marine supplied the Ceiba-2 cable, not this facility. chinese_entities 'ZTE' → empty: cleared with chinese_involvement. open_source_stack 'Predominantly proprietary' → 'Unknown': no source describes the software stack. data_residency_guarantee 'Yes, contractual guarantee' → 'Unknown': no source mentions a residency guarantee. ixp_presence 'No IXP connection' → 'Unknown': no source addresses IXP connection. control_confidence 'high' → 'low': only the World Bank diagnostic states that GITGE is state-owned.

Evidence check. government_ownership_pct rewritten: no source shows direct state ownership of the data centre; Gamtel's two holders are both state bodies. govt_data_hosted 'Designated national / government data centre' → 'Unknown': the national Tier-2 data centre Gamtel manages for government is not placed at Kairaba by any source. expansion_plans 'No plans' → 'Unknown': no source addresses expansion; the contemplated Tier-4 is a separate facility. key_tenants 'Government of Gambia; ISPs; SMBs' → 'SIXP (Serrekunda Internet Exchange Point)': only SIXP is confirmed in the building; ISPs and SMBs are target customers of Gamtel's co-location offer. chinese_involvement 'Construction/Equipment' → 'None identified': the Huawei-built GNBN data centre is not placed at Kairaba by any source. chinese_entities 'Huawei' → empty: cleared with chinese_involvement. data_residency_guarantee 'Partial (some data classes)' → 'Unknown': no source mentions a residency guarantee. local_dp_compliance 'No claim' → 'Unknown': no source addresses data protection compliance.

Evidence check. operator_name rewritten: Telecompaper names ANADEN and Comores Cables as co-managers. services_offered rewritten: the e-services, payment and data-exchange platforms are AfDB programme components, not services the facility advertises. investment_usd '24900000' → empty: $24.9M is the whole AfDB digitisation programme (platforms, incubator and two data centres), not this facility. dfi_involvement rewritten: no source says the AfDB project is separate from this facility, or that it is the same one. expansion_plans 'Planned' → 'Unknown': expansion is only listed among a future PPP operator's duties; no plan is announced. chinese_involvement 'Construction/Equipment' → 'None identified': Huawei's Exim-financed work was Comores Telecom's fibre backbone, not this facility. chinese_entities 'Huawei' → empty: cleared with chinese_involvement. data_residency_guarantee 'Partial (some data classes)' → 'Unknown': no source mentions a residency guarantee. local_dp_compliance 'No claim' → 'Unknown': compliance with international standards is claimed, not with a Comorian law. ixp_presence 'No IXP connection' → 'Unknown': the only IXP source predates the facility by a decade. control_confidence 'high' → 'low': only Telecompaper speaks to this facility, and it names co-managers, not an owner.

Evidence check. major_shareholders rewritten: no source names Anthony Same as a shareholder or gives the size of UHURU's stake. foreign_ownership_pct rewritten: UHURU is Nigerian, so its stake is foreign, and its size is not disclosed. recent_investments filled: DCD reports the investment; it is at company level and pays for builds outside Cameroon. expansion_plans 'Under construction' → 'Unknown': the builds under way are in Gabon, Côte d'Ivoire and Togo, not at DLA01. key_tenants rewritten: no source names Camtel, Orange or MTN as tenants, and TechCabal names Camtel and Orange as rival operators. chinese_involvement 'Construction/Equipment' → 'None identified': no source names Huawei or ZTE at this facility. chinese_entities 'Huawei|ZTE' → empty: cleared with chinese_involvement. open_source_stack 'Mixed open source and proprietary' → 'Unknown': no source describes the software stack. data_residency_guarantee 'Partial (some data classes)' → 'Unknown': sovereign-cloud marketing is not a contractual residency guarantee. local_dp_compliance 'No claim' → 'Unknown': no source addresses Cameroon's data protection law. ixp_presence 'IXP connected (not hosted)' → 'IXP hosted on-site': Data Center POST says DLA01 houses DOUALA-IX. gpu_ai_capability 'No evidence' → 'Yes, confirmed GPU/AI infrastructure': the minister cited AI-specific equipment at the Douala data centre on a July 2025 visit. security_certifications 'Unknown' → 'DC OIX-2; ISO 27001; TIA-942; HDS': Open-IX certified DLA01 as DC OIX-2, and ST Digital states ISO 27001, TIA-942 and HDS for its data centres.

Evidence check. ultimate_parent_company rewritten: Greenline's September 2025 release says final scope, ownership and financing remain subject to approvals and definitive agreements. control_mechanisms rewritten: no equity has been agreed; the parties are still structuring the PPP. control_rationale rewritten: the old rationale said nothing about what the category rests on. recent_investments rewritten: Grand Parakou is a different Greenline facility in Benin, and the $150M is announced, not committed. expansion_plans 'Under construction' → 'Unknown': the facility is itself only planned; no source addresses expansion. govt_data_hosted 'Designated national / government data centre' → 'Unknown': the release calls it a national digital hub but says nothing about hosting government data. key_tenants 'Government; telecom operators' → 'None confirmed (facility planned)': no tenant is named; the release lists stakeholders, not tenants. hyperscaler_relationships rewritten: reselling Microsoft licences is not a relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_microsoft 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_aws 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_google 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility.

Evidence check. ownership_type 'Joint venture (majority domestic)' → 'Government / SOE': DCD (2021) and Xalam (July 2025) both say SIN, a Togolese state enterprise, owns the facility; Africa Data Centres only operates it. ownership_structure_type 'Private; foreign-controlled subsidiary chain' → 'State-owned enterprise': the owner is SIN, a state enterprise, not the Cassava chain. parent_company rewritten: SIN owns the facility; Liquid's Africa Data Centres manages it. parent_hq_country 'ZAF' → 'TGO': SIN manages the Togolese state's digital assets. ultimate_parent_company 'Cassava Technologies' → 'Government of Togo': SIN is state-owned. ultimate_parent_hq_country 'ZWE' → 'TGO': the owner is the Togolese state. major_shareholders rewritten: Cassava is the operator's group, not the owner, so its register is labelled as such. government_ownership_pct empty → 'Majority, via SIN (state-owned); exact share not disclosed': Xalam calls the facility largely state-owned and government-controlled. foreign_ownership_pct '100%' → 'None identified (owner SIN is a Togolese state enterprise)': the 100% figure was the operator's group, which holds no equity in the facility. controlling_entities rewritten: SIN owns the facility; Cassava's subsidiary operates it. control_mechanisms rewritten: DCD says SIN owns it and ADC manages and operates it. control_rationale rewritten: control rests with the Togolese state as owner, not with Econet or Cassava. dfi_involvement rewritten: the facility's own DFI finance is the World Bank loan; the Cassava and IFC positions are in the operator's group. key_tenants 'Government of Togo; banks; telecoms; ISPs' → 'Government of Togo (100 m² reserved)': sources reserve space for the government; banks, telecoms and ISPs are categories, not named tenants. expansion_plans 'Under construction' → 'Unknown': Xalam's capacity under construction is market-wide and names no facility. hyperscaler_relationships rewritten: the Google Interconnect, Azure Stack in Zambia and IFC hyperscale builds are group-level or elsewhere; Google's Cassava stake is not in this SIN-owned facility, and Equiano lands at a separate station reached by terrestrial link. hyperscaler_microsoft 'Yes' → 'No': the Azure Stack hosting is in Zambia. hyperscaler_google 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility; its operator is not the Equiano partner and it is not the landing. data_residency_guarantee 'Yes, contractual guarantee' → 'Unknown': no source mentions a residency guarantee. local_dp_compliance 'Self-declared compliant' → 'Unknown': sources describe Togo's 2019 law but no operator claim of compliance. ixp_presence 'IXP hosted on-site' → 'Unknown': no source addresses an IXP.

Evidence check. ultimate_parent_company rewritten: LinkedIn lists a privately held company and no source names an owner; the 'likely' owners and the Cloud Factory/NETMASTER role are unsourced. controlling_entities rewritten: no source names an owner. major_shareholders 'Not publicly disclosed; CEO Ayikido Noagbodji (Togolese)' → 'Not publicly disclosed': no source names a shareholder, and the CEO is not shown to hold shares. control_confidence 'high' → 'low': only LinkedIn's 'privately held' and a Lomé HQ; no source names the owners. carrier_neutrality 'Limited carriers' → 'Fully carrier-neutral': the operator's site and LinkedIn both call it carrier-neutral with a multi-operator meet-me room. gps_coordinates '6.1375, 1.2244' → '6.1667, 1.2167': the operator's site gives 06°10′N 01°13′E (approximate), matching Data Center Map's 3.3 km from the Lomé Data Centre; the old point was 1.3 km away. govt_data_hosted 'No government data' → 'Unknown': the site targets public institutions but names none as clients. expansion_plans 'No plans' → 'Unknown': no source addresses expansion. local_dp_compliance 'Self-declared compliant' → 'Unknown': the site claims data stays in Togo but makes no data protection compliance claim. ixp_presence 'No IXP connection' → 'Unknown': no source addresses an IXP.

Evidence check. chinese_involvement 'Construction/Equipment' → 'Investment': Trade.gov says Huawei broke ground on the national data centre in 2020 on a China EXIM Bank concessional loan, and the World Bank puts PMICE on Eximbank finance. chinese_entities 'Huawei' → 'Huawei|China EXIM Bank': Huawei builds, China EXIM Bank lends. recent_investments filled: DCD gives the investor, amount and start. key_tenants 'Government ministries; state agencies' → 'None named': the facility is under construction and no source names a tenant. expansion_plans 'Planned' → 'Unknown': the World Bank's 'national backup' is a second site, and no source addresses expansion. ixp_presence 'No IXP connection' → 'Unknown': the World Bank mentions an IXP planned at ADETIC but nothing links it to this facility.

Evidence check. ownership_type 'Joint venture (majority foreign)' → 'Unknown': sources say MGI manages the National Data Centre; none says who owns it or that it is a joint venture. ultimate_parent_company rewritten: the Zug register lists the two Gibreil Musas as board members, not as owners. controlling_entities rewritten: sources give MGI management control; its owners are not disclosed. control_mechanisms rewritten: the sources describe MGI managing the facility, not an equity stake. government_ownership_pct '0% (no evidence)' → empty: not disclosed; 0% was an inference from absent evidence. control_confidence 'high' → 'low': MGI's role rests on one press release reprinted twice, and the facility's ownership is unknown. govt_data_hosted 'Unknown' → 'Designated national / government data centre': every source calls it the National Data Centre, under an NCA oversight committee. key_tenants 'Government of South Sudan; NCA' → 'None named': no source names a tenant. expansion_plans 'No plans' → 'Unknown': sources mention modernisation, not expansion.

Evidence check. foreign_ownership_pct '0% (Spanish HQ and control)' → empty: the operator belongs to a Spain-registered group, so 0% is wrong, and no source gives the stake. hyperscaler_relationships rewritten: the Google, AWS and Azure peering is group-wide IP transit, not a relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_microsoft 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_aws 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_google 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. dfi_involvement rewritten: both grants fund the group's Medusa cable, not this facility, and the EIB's €40M went to GÉANT. govt_data_hosted 'No government data' → 'Unknown': no source addresses government hosting; the operator says it serves public institutions. expansion_plans 'No plans' → 'Unknown': no source addresses expansion. ixp_presence 'IXP connected (not hosted)' → 'Unknown': the group's IXP interconnections are not placed at this facility. carrier_neutrality 'Fully carrier-neutral' → 'Unknown': an ISP's own colocation; no source says tenants may choose another carrier.

Evidence check. ownership_type 'PPP' → 'Government / SOE': SDIN, 100% state-owned, owns the facility; the three private telecoms sit only in IMT, the operating GIE. investment_usd '15000000' → '17320000': the EIB loan is €15M, which DCD converts to $17.32M; 15000000 was the euro figure. security_certifications 'Unknown' → 'Uptime Institute Tier III': EIB and EEAS say the loan paid for Uptime Tier III certification, which the facility received. key_tenants rewritten: the three telecoms are IMT's members, not named tenants, and banks are a target in EIB's release. hyperscaler_relationships rewritten: the cited PDF is a state-enterprise register and says nothing of hyperscalers. expansion_plans 'Planned' → 'Unknown': no source addresses expansion. data_residency_guarantee 'Yes, contractual guarantee' → 'Unknown': sources say the centre lets Mauritania host national data at home, not that any contract guarantees it. ixp_presence 'IXP connected (not hosted)' → 'Unknown': no source addresses IXP connection.

Evidence check. chinese_involvement 'Construction/Equipment' → 'None identified': DCD (Feb 2026) says Huawei's earlier Tier III project was not mentioned at the launch; no source ties Huawei to this facility. chinese_entities 'Huawei' → empty: cleared with chinese_involvement. key_tenants rewritten: sources name the Malian state as the user; AES hosting is described as a near-term aim, not a tenancy. expansion_plans 'No plans' → 'Unknown': no source addresses expansion. data_residency_guarantee 'Partial (some data classes)' → 'Unknown': sources describe a policy of repatriating state data, not a contractual guarantee. ixp_presence 'IXP connected (not hosted)' → 'Unknown': no source addresses IXP connection.

Evidence check. parent_company 'Bharti Airtel' → 'Airtel Africa plc': Airtel (Seychelles) Limited is a 100% subsidiary in Airtel Africa plc's accounts; Bharti Airtel is two levels up. parent_hq_country 'IND' → 'GBR': Airtel Africa plc reports under the UK Companies Act. major_shareholders rewritten: the current register gives Bharti Airtel 79.42%, not 62.33%, and no longer lists Warburg Pincus or GIC. foreign_ownership_pct rewritten: the field is the owning entity's foreign share, and the operator is a wholly owned subsidiary; the old figure was Airtel Africa plc's non-Indian float. control_mechanisms rewritten: the stake is 79.42% on the current register, not ~62%. recent_investments rewritten: the Lagos and Nairobi builds are other facilities, and BusinessDay puts Lagos's go-live at 2028, not 2026. dfi_involvement rewritten: neither loan reaches Seychelles, BII has exited, and no source gives the 2025 Kenya/Rwanda $100M. expansion_plans 'No plans' → 'Unknown': no source addresses expansion. key_tenants 'Airtel Seychelles subscribers; Enterprise; Government' → 'Airtel Seychelles (its own network core)': no tenant is named; the only confirmed occupant is Airtel's own core network. govt_data_hosted 'No government data' → 'Unknown': no source addresses government hosting. hyperscaler_relationships rewritten: Nxtra's hopes of hyperscale tenants concern its Lagos and Nairobi builds; nothing links a hyperscaler to this facility. hyperscaler_microsoft 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_aws 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. hyperscaler_google 'Yes' → 'No': no relationship at this facility. chinese_involvement 'Ownership' → 'None identified': no source names a Chinese party; Ericsson built and fitted the facility. chinese_entities 'Huawei|ZTE' → empty: cleared with chinese_involvement. cloud_platform rewritten: Ericsson's release describes the platform. open_source_stack 'Mixed open source and proprietary' → 'Unknown': no source describes the software stack. data_residency_guarantee 'Yes, contractual guarantee' → 'Unknown': no source mentions a residency guarantee. local_dp_compliance 'No claim' → 'Unknown': no source addresses data protection compliance. ixp_presence 'No IXP connection' → 'Unknown': no source addresses IXP connection.
